SeoContent_P2: Privacy comes from the architecture: the site is a set of static pages, and every tool processes your input inside the browser. Compute-heavy tools such as hashing, encryption, image, PDF and QR processing run in WebAssembly modules compiled from Rust; lighter ones, like the JSON formatter or the text diff, are plain JavaScript. The passwords, keys and files you work with are never uploaded.
NoDataSent: No data is sent to the server
FeatureAlgorithmsDescription: Star the tools you use most. Favorites and recently used tools are kept in your browser.
FeatureWasmDescription: Hashing, encryption, image and PDF processing run in Rust-compiled WebAssembly; simpler tools are lightweight JavaScript.
FeaturePrivacyDescription: Your input is processed in the browser and is never sent to a server.
FeatureFreeDescription: All tools are free. No hidden payments or subscriptions.
SeoContent_P1: MyDevTools is a free collection of browser-based developer utilities: formatters and validators for JSON, XML and YAML, Base64, Hex and URL encoders, hash and HMAC calculators, JWT and X.509 tools, a regex tester, image and PDF utilities, and generators for UUIDs, passwords and QR codes. There is nothing to install and no account to create.
Title: Online Developer Tools — MyDevTools (All in Browser)
Subtitle: Free developer tools for JSON, Base64, hashes, JWT, regex, images, PDF and more. Everything runs locally in your browser, and your data is never uploaded.
FeatureOfflineDescription: Once a page has been opened, it keeps working without a connection. Install the PWA for quick access.
FeatureLanguagesDescription: The interface and tool guides are available in 10 languages.
